questions.q:
What is the ratio of the sum of first seven prime numbers to the sum of first 8 odd natural numbers?

प्रथम सात अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग और प्रथम 8 विषम प्राकृत संख्याओं के योग का अनुपात कितना है?
questions.s:
First seven prime numbers = 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17

Sum of first seven prime numbers = 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 11 + 13 + 17 = 58

First eight odd natural number = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15

Sum of first eight odd natural numbers = 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 + 11 + 13 + 15 = 64

Required ratio = 58: 64 = 29: 32

questions.q: 1. The sum of three consecutive multiples of 9 is 2457, find the largest one.
questions.s:
1.(a)

Let the first multiple of 9 be x.

9x + 9(x + 1) + 9(x + 2) = 2457

⇒9x + 9x + 9 + 9x + 18 = 2457

⇒27x = 2457 - 27

⇒27x = 2430 ⇒x =  90

Largest number = 9 × ( 90 + 2 ) = 9 × 92 = 828

questions.q:
How many numbers are there from 200 to 800 which are neither divisible by 5 nor by 7?

200 से 800 तक ऐसी कितनी संख्याएँ हैं जो न तो 5 से और न ही 7 से विभाज्य हैं?
o: 107
410
413
411
questions.s:
Video Solution available in detailed maths course.

Total numbers from 200 to 800: = 800 – 200 +1 = 601

Divisible by 5:

800/5 – 199/5 = 160 – 39 = 121

Divisible by 7:

800/7 – 1999/7 = 114 – 28 = 86

Divisible by both 5 & 7 = 35 (LCM)

800/35 – 199/35 = 22 – 5 = 17

Numbers divisible by 5 or 7:

121 + 86 – 17 = 190

Numbers neither divisible by 5 nor by 7:

601 – 190 = 411 (answer)

questions.q:
a, b, c and 23 are four distinct numbers and the HCF of each pair of numbers (23, a), (23, b), (23, c) is 23 where a, b, c are each less than 95 and a < b < c. What is the value of (b * c + a)/2?

a, b, c और 23 चार अलग-अलग संख्याएँ हैं और संख्याओं के प्रत्येक जोड़े (23, a), (23, b), (23, c) का HCF 23 है जहाँ a, b, c प्रत्येक 95 से कम हैं और a < b < c है। (b * c + a)/2 का मान क्या है?
questions.s:
The four distinct numbers are 23, a, b and c.

HCF is always the factor of the given numbers.

a, b, c should be multiple of 23 as the HCF is 23.

Only possible multiples of 23 are 2, 3 and 4.

a, b and c each are less than 95 and a < b < c.

So, a = 23 * 2 = 46

b = 23 * 3 = 69

c = 23 * 4 = 92

(b * c + a)/2 = (69 * 92 + 46)/2

= (6348 + 46)/2 = 6394/2 = 3197

questions.s:
We know that to find the number of zeroes in any expression, all we need to do is to count the number of 5's.

Therefore,

181/5: Quotient 36.

36/5: Quotient 7.

7/5: Quotient 1.

Total number of 5's = 36 + 7 + 1 = 44

Total number of zeroes = 44

How many numbers are there from 200 to 800 which are neither divisible by 5 nor by 7?

200 से 800 तक ऐसी कितनी संख्याएँ हैं जो न तो 5 से और न ही 7 से विभाज्य हैं?
o_hi: 107
410
413
411
questions_hin.s_hi:
Video Solution available in detailed maths course.

Total numbers from 200 to 800: = 800 – 200 +1 = 601

Divisible by 5:

800/5 – 199/5 = 160 – 39 = 121

Divisible by 7:

800/7 – 1999/7 = 114 – 28 = 86

Divisible by both 5 & 7 = 35 (LCM)

800/35 – 199/35 = 22 – 5 = 17

Numbers divisible by 5 or 7:

121 + 86 – 17 = 190

Numbers neither divisible by 5 nor by 7:

601 – 190 = 411 (answer)

questions_hin.q_hi: 4. पाँच अंकों की वह छोटी से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 472 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो।
questions_hin.s_hi:
4.(b) पाँच अंकों की सबसे छोटी संख्या = 10000
जब हम 10000 को 472 से भाग देते हैं, तो शेषफल = 88
472 - 88 = 384 को 10000 में  5 अंकों की छोटी से छोटी संख्या के लिए जोड़ा जाना चाहिए।
आवश्यक न्यूनतम 5 अंकों की संख्या = 10000+ 384 = 10384

questions_hin.q_hi: 1. दो संख्याओं का योग 27 है। एक संख्या का पांच गुना, दूसरी संख्या के 4 गुने के बराबर है। इन दोनों संख्याओं में से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions_hin.s_hi:
1.(b)

माना पहली संख्या x है तो दूसरी संख्या = (27 - x)

5x = 4 (27 - x)

⇒ 5x + 4x = 108 ⇒ 9x = 108 ⇒ x = 12

छोटी संख्या = 12

x3451 को 3 से विभाज्य होने के लिए,

questions_hin.q_hi:
a, b, c and 23 are four distinct numbers and the HCF of each pair of numbers (23, a), (23, b), (23, c) is 23 where a, b, c are each less than 95 and a < b < c. What is the value of (b * c + a)/2?

a, b, c और 23 चार अलग-अलग संख्याएँ हैं और संख्याओं के प्रत्येक जोड़े (23, a), (23, b), (23, c) का HCF 23 है जहाँ a, b, c प्रत्येक 95 से कम हैं और a < b < c है। (b * c + a)/2 का मान क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
The four distinct numbers are 23, a, b and c.

HCF is always the factor of the given numbers.

a, b, c should be multiple of 23 as the HCF is 23.

Only possible multiples of 23 are 2, 3 and 4.

a, b and c each are less than 95 and a < b < c.

So, a = 23 * 2 = 46

b = 23 * 3 = 69

c = 23 * 4 = 92

(b * c + a)/2 = (69 * 92 + 46)/2

= (6348 + 46)/2 = 6394/2 = 3197

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find the number of zeroes in 181!

181 में शून्यों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए!
questions_hin.s_hi:
We know that to find the number of zeroes in any expression, all we need to do is to count the number of 5's.

Therefore,

181/5: Quotient 36.

36/5: Quotient 7.

7/5: Quotient 1.

Total number of 5's = 36 + 7 + 1 = 44

Total number of zeroes = 44

questions_hin.q_hi: 8. पाँच क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का योग 2720 है। तीसरी और पाँचवीं संख्याओं का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

The LCM of x2 − 8x + 15 and x2 − 5x + 6 is:

x2 − 8x + 15 और x2 − 5x + 6 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) है:
questions_hin.s_hi:
Factors of x2 - 8x+15 = (x-3) (x-5)

Factors of x2−5x+6 = (x-3) (x-2)

LCM = (x-2) (x-3) (x-5)
